title: The Hostel Kitchen
body: Kaveri University's six hostels (4,800 students) are fed by one caterer, Annapurna Mess Services, which cooks 12,600 plates a day and throws away 2,900 of them (23%). A waste audit above 20% costs Annapurna a ₹50,000 penalty, and the university must halve food waste within a year. Build the company that gets the food that is cooked to the students who want it. Read the full case pack (exhibits 1–5) before you write the pitch.
